vision.name: Blue Mimicry Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your opponent cannot use Endurance on your copied attacks.
[Instant] POWER: Use after performing a successful copied attack. Destroy the top 2 cards of your Life Deck to draw a card.
POWER: Shuffle up to 3 cards with "copy" or "copied" in the text-box or parenthetical text from your discard pile into your Life Deck.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title strip below the art (read from a crop of the original); DR (alternate-art tier) number printed
